# Released Meeting recording and desktop ownership

The immutable reference remains v1.6.0 at `5202477edfe4b5d8bacfa5b2e9fd6eadd9624f7f`. The additional [joined recording fixture](../../../mluva-workflows/tests/fixtures/released-meeting-session.json), SHA-256 `7f0a574c51aedb3e2f264e807651931376c94dc63456118a1e31ab9bcd669ab3`, comes from fourteen transactions through the actual released PipeWireMeetingRecorder, WAV mixing, MeetingWorkflow and ElevenLabs HTTP client. The [desktop owner fixture](released-meeting-controller.json), SHA-256 `3108041f667ff2e8b0aec6ef583291e6b15bbfa33714bd87f9861cb549fbdc51`, comes from nine actual released MluvaApplication Meeting workflows/47 GTK states. Each external observer checks all imported application module bytes against the reference commit. Native checks consume these frozen outputs without invoking an interpreter.

MeetingRecorder owns both external capture processes and the staging/final audio on one dedicated worker. Stop/mixing never executes on the GTK context. Explicit transfer preserves indexed/recoverable audio; closing or dropping an untransferred result erases it. Session construction freezes the identifier, wall timestamp and privacy, requires persistent audio to use its archive directory, and rejects a storage/privacy mismatch. Incognito uses the actual native memory store and cleanup helper. Every capture/retry creates a fresh HTTP transport from the readiness owner's credential/path snapshot, so a completed or closed client cannot disable the next operation.

The joined recording check matches released WAV/provenance/warning/duration results, exact uploaded bytes/fields, portable records, private file/index bytes and permissions, successful retention, recognition/index failures, Incognito erasure and cancellation before Stop. It includes all five previously frozen audio cases in retained and Incognito forms. Additional native faults abort a slow Stop caller while timers keep running, preserve an unowned destination collision, and close sessions during slow finalization or a delayed actual HTTP response in both privacy modes. They reap both processes, erase untransferred audio and memory staging, leave no archive index, and reject terminal phase/index publication after close.

MeetingController now owns the real MeetingPage and joins it to ApplicationServices, CapturePage and CapturePreferences. The explicitly executed private GTK check matches normal recording, microphone/system fallback warnings, neither-source failure, Incognito completion/failure, failed retained recognition followed by explicit retry, failed index/manual transcript recovery and cancellation. It compares the actual buttons, selective capture/settings locks, frozen privacy summary, Meeting-only status messages, private archive/audio, content-free diagnostic stages, processing/retry/delete guards and both surfaces' return to idle. Processing is locked synchronously before dispatch, preventing repeated Stop from launching another completion. Capture/retry and filesystem/provider work execute on the background runtime; weak/owned-session checks prevent late UI callbacks after exit. The explicit shutdown task waits for the session/retry owner and must be awaited by the eventual root application before Quit.

Generated UUIDs, portable-record timestamps and their filename/path appearances are normalized. At in-flight processing/retry snapshots, external-process active state, finalization file inventory and diagnostic inventory are marked `in-flight`: their asynchronous publication order is not a stable snapshot boundary. Their exact final audio, record/index and diagnostic results are checked at terminal states; recording snapshots also compare the source files and ready diagnostic. Other fields/messages remain literal. The desktop test controls only the external PCM/HTTP peers and unrelated parent ports; the actual released application methods and actual native owner perform capture/Stop/retry/cancel/delete-guard logic. The parent window, capture provider, review and key owners are not assembled as a full application in this check.

Reproduce from the repository root with scratch under `tmp/`:

```sh
cargo build --locked -p mluva-audio --bin audio-fixture-peer --bin mluva-audio-cleanup
cargo test --locked -p mluva-audio --test audio_contracts
cargo test --locked -p mluva-workflows --test meeting
bash dev/run-isolated-browser.sh tmp/native-meeting-owner -- \
  cargo test --locked -p mluva-gtk --test meeting_controller -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
```

Desktop comparisons isolate display, HOME/XDG, session/accessibility buses, network/PID/mount namespaces and input/audio/GPU nodes. Only synthetic PCM, synthetic credentials and owned loopback providers are used. Source observers/raw logs stay ignored scratch; fixture binaries are not selected by distribution. No host microphone/input/focus, real account/content upload or installed configuration is used.

This is bounded owner integration, not complete application or Meeting acceptance. Root window/services/Settings reconfiguration, physical microphone/system audio and keys, complete pending-review/History/recovery workflows, broader accessibility/scales, final packaging/Python removal and same-machine performance remain required. All complete-workflow matrix rows stay Pending. No complete runnable native app or Rust install/merge/release is claimed; the verified installed app/widget remain 1.6.0 and the full Rust goal remains active.

## Actual root application

5 October 2026: [the joined Meeting fixture](released-bootstrap-meeting.json), SHA-256 `411d3e40d98995143da0d78e22403465a691d6736206083696f71922994765e0`, adds three independently launched unchanged-release/native app pairs and 22 states to `released_process_actions_residency_and_headless_dispatch`. Real root settings, credential/device discovery, capture children, WAV mixing, the fixed certificate-validated ElevenLabs HTTPS endpoint and archive/UI callbacks are assembled. Retained failure/Retry preserves the original raw ID/timestamp/filename; Incognito failure erases audio without an archive; failed system capture preserves microphone audio. Busy Dictation guards and untouched clipboard/empty History hold with all automatic copy/paste flags enabled. All four actual multipart requests match, including complete WAVs and `scribe_v2`/Czech/diarization fields.

The 49,655-byte source-only fixture shares 74 widget entries across twelve inventories/21 observations without losing duplicates or named/text UI values. Generated identity/date/root/RAM names and bounded recording elapsed labels normalize; all other observed fields stay exact. Native removes the release's empty Incognito folder at terminal failure instead of Quit; this singleton improvement does not hide a source audio leak. Normal Quit preserves retained data/audio and reaps capture/RAM. Raw full frames remain unmasked, without full pixel-equality or focus/platform claims.

Build the additional private HTTPS prerequisite, then use the [existing bootstrap reproduction command](bootstrap-managed-capture-evidence.md):

```sh
cargo build --locked -p mluva-gtk --example artifact_https_peer
```

The runner requires `openssl` and private network/PID/devices/RAM/HOME/display/buses; no host input, physical audio, real key/account/content or cloud call is used. The same owner passes all prior contracts plus these cases in 758.07 seconds. The unchanged artifact GET branch separately passes eighteen first-run states with actual local CPU recognition; the normal gate passes 142 tests, both strict Clippy configurations, formatting and generated consistency. [The compact evidence](../../../../docs/verification/rust-worker-lifecycle/joined-meeting.json) preserves inputs, observer failures, native/raw results, earlier oracles and package fingerprints. No production change, extra test/ignored owner, dependency or shipped helper is added. Root reconfiguration/readiness, index/title/export/delete/session interleavings and physical/Wayland/platform acceptance remain open; complete-workflow matrix statuses and published/installed 2.0.0 stay unchanged.

## Title, export and deletion through the current application

Later on 5 October 2026: the retained failure/Retry route extends from ten to 26 states. Delete during held Retry is declined without losing the original record/WAV. After recovery, actual controls trim/save a Unicode title, explicitly copy the transcript, dismiss the notice, export complete Markdown/JSON, cancel deletion, clear a whitespace-only title, overwrite both exports, and confirm deletion. Only the owned archive row/WAV disappear; the clipboard and exports survive deletion, and exports/settings survive normal Quit. Dictation History/replies stay empty with every automatic copy/paste flag enabled.

All additional expected values come from a separately launched immutable v1.6.0 package. Its 91 runtime inputs match the reference Git blobs. The source-only fixture is now 103,420 bytes, SHA-256 `2291652fbc22703b6512790adf02c2c1fb16f9e8488b255af5da30f6ed77e8f6`; it shares 93 widget entries, 26 inventories and five full export values. The original observation/widget array prefixes and the complete Incognito/fallback cases remain unchanged. Nine preceding retained states reconstruct identically; the busy Dictation message after the new Delete attempt is independently observed rather than masked. After Quit, the source's persisted export bytes/private modes and complete configuration values still match the captured observations.

The existing owner can select Meeting alone through `MLUVA_TEST_MEETING_ONLY=1`. This runs the same three cases/38 states against the real relocated package, without a second test owner or production switch. Build the prerequisites above, then select the current prepared bundle inside the private runner:

```sh
bash dev/run-isolated-browser.sh tmp/native-meeting-archive -- \
  env MLUVA_TEST_QWEN_PCM="$PWD/tmp/native-bootstrap-input/asr-en.pcm" \
  MLUVA_TEST_NATIVE_BUNDLE=/absolute/prepared-native-bundle \
  MLUVA_TEST_MEETING_ONLY=1 \
  cargo test --locked -p mluva-gtk --test bootstrap \
  released_process_actions_residency_and_headless_dispatch -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
```

The published 2.0.2 package passes all 38 states in 69.50 seconds with zero application/TLS diagnostics and acknowledged Quit. The current app SHA-256 is `37e6628f0e29abe1b147eaeb976501ab34e1411ccefecab9efa14205c4f9bca0`; all 520 payloads/four managed links match its receipt. Absolute Python/python3/uv traps are positively exercised, then unused. Exports retain full normalized UTF-8 text and 0600 file/0700 directory modes. Only validated generated UUID/date/root/RAM/export-filename components normalize; raw hashes/bytes remain in the evidence. Each elapsed label must fall inside the measured input/readiness-to-snapshot interval, allowing the one-second GTK timer tick before its volatile clock is aliased. Raw frames stay unmasked, without a whole-window pixel claim.

The complete primary owner also passes in 795.42 seconds against the earlier canonical prepared 2.0.0 bundle (`bf1082081c4f0c05dd09bb3793a3e4d85ad7e28c35f171e80aba58b359dacce1`). This preserves the original bootstrap, complete final/cancel pixels, cold Record, Qwen expiry/recovery, History, Live/current SDK, startup faults and CLI contracts alongside all 38 Meeting states. An initial current-package whole-root run fails at the old Rewrite composer baseline: 2.0.2 intentionally starts that panel collapsed. The original bootstrap and whole-window pixel oracles remain unchanged; this checkpoint does not establish current-version whole-root parity. The eight-second test-provider response hold expired during the added dialog observations; Meeting now explicitly requests a bounded 60-second hold, leaving other responses at eight seconds. A fixed elapsed-label sample and a stale accessibility node during final deletion also caused observer failures; measured timer bounds and actual dialog-button waits repair those observations without changing the app. The [archive report](../../../../docs/verification/rust-worker-lifecycle/joined-meeting-archive.json) records the accepted runs and exclusions. Reconfiguration/readiness, broader index/revision interleavings, physical audio/keys/Wayland and other platform acceptance remain open; no complete-workflow matrix row closes.
